en: Don't think I remember you.
We talked a few years back. It was the only time I tried hiring a Vulture when I was still a farmer. You seemed so strange to me.
Now I talk to you guys all the time. Appreciate the consistency of a Vulture compared to other Factions... Sorry about the Villa thing. Hope y'all can find a place to be safe.
So... I did a job for you?
I think you took care of some Mutants for me and some other folks. No wonder you don't remember it, must've been a snooze. I was scared of your gas mask and how curt you were.
Hmm... A Mutant gig, no?
Wow, I'm... Surprised you remembered. Yeah, we were dealing with a lot of dog attacks... So many dead that year. You and your colleagues really helped out.
This whole area... Belongs to the Rada?
"Belong" is a strong word, hah. Mostly Commonfolk live here, but we help get them installed, and we negotiate with Palatines for security. We have some authority here, but...
Not enough. The kind of confidence we need to inspire so we can call the shots and make things run smoothly... That'll only come when we can protect people directly. No middle-men.
You think the Rada should be combat-ready?
Yes. It's way past time. No organization can survive without violence. The exceptions prove the rule, as they all have the means to hire violent people to do the dirty work.
Sounds like you just want control over Commonfolk.

Control based on trust works both ways. Our guns will be aimed at Bandits and Mutants, not at the common man. If we betray that, we'll be violently deposed: it's part of the plan to eventually teach them to arm themselves...
Or do you think we're less trustworthy than the Palatines?
Thought Rada were... Pacifists.
Who told you that? We have a particular view of how violence must be used, sure, but... Was it Mila who put that idea in your head?
About the Rada using force...
Yes?
Is there no hope to make things better soon?
I don't believe in quick, easy change. We will arm ourselves over the months and years, but even so, the Bandits will not disappear, they will dwindle.

Gunners will not give up their expansion, they will be discouraged. Mutants will not stop ruining our crops, and our own ruinous habits will persist: we'll dissolve them slowly through education and cooperative work.
None of this will last unless we build a social fabric where it is the only way to live.
Never mind; I have to go.
Other Rada I talked to were all about peace.
I wouldn't mind some of that, myself. But just because we want a better world, does not mean we should offer flowers to those who would see us dead.
If we're entrusted with all the farms in Zalesye, we'll have to keep them while applying our ideas in practice. History doesn't operate in short bursts of heroics, it's a war of attrition.
Won't this lead us back to the same power imbalance?
There's always a chance that the oppressed will become oppressors themselves... But we must try to break that cycle.

Whatever society we build will contain within it the infected, nefarious essence of the times we're going through right now. Which is why we must make an effort to qualify our use of weapons from the start.
That's all I wanted to ask.
Hmm... I see.
The bunker down there? That's off-limits. Mutants, radiation, even the ceiling's about to give. Next person to slam that door will probably get buried alive, so, sorry.

Our security's stretched too thin, man. It's bad enough that we had to post guards there to avoid people trying to sneak in... Too many deaths... We're way too vulnerable right now. No shenanigans, please.
Can handle all of that. Really need to get in there.
Shit... Look, how 'bout a trade? You help us with our security problem... I'll give you the key. But I'm warning you... That place spells death.
I won't ask for much... Just... A few weapons. You're crafty, I'm sure. Give us something to help the Rada start getting its hands dirty. I'll give you the blueprints, just make the weapons for us.
None of that's my concern. Just let me in.
If you have a death wish, Returner, I won't be too stubborn with this. But you gotta understand if I ask you to do something for us, first. Like... Making a couple guns for us.
Help us arm our Rada rookies and I'll lend you that bunker's key and give you a reward as well. How's that?
Crafting weapons for you? Sounds easy.
Glad to hear it. Here are the blueprints.
I'll think about it.
Don't let me hear you trying to break in during the night.
Not interested in running errands for you.
I guess you'll be shooting me sometime soon, then? It's okay, no one will miss me.
What guns do you need?
A couple of higher-caliber weapons should do it. We’ve got a few pistols from our Palatine friends, but that’s not enough to defend oneself anymore, is it? Things've been getting worse...
Oh, give us something with <u>good ergonomics,</u> too. These people are beginners, so an easy grip, not too much recoil, that'll help 'em build their confidence...
Where can I go to craft the guns?
Oh, you don't have to do it nearby; my brothers and sisters are still learning the basics of gun safety, it'll be a while before I show 'em how to put a weapon together. Maintenance and all that.
But if you want, we do have a <u>workbench</u> somewhere around here; feel free to use it. There'll be curious eyes watchin', though.
I don't have any more questions.
Good. There's still time to reconsider your brave exploration, Returner.
Hey, Returner. You done with those weapons? Lemme at 'em.
Not yet.
Okay, I guess you can take your time. You're the one who seemed impatient before, after all.
Had some questions first.
Forgot what type of gun we want?
Oh, so you did. Let's take a look... Hey, these look good. Great job, Returner. Somehow I knew I could count on you. You've been a Vulture for many many years, after all...
Here's the key to that old bunker. I'll tell our guards to let you pass. Just... Be careful and try not to break anything, alright? That place could hold some really valuable resources for us...
What about that other reward?
Oh yeah, of course. Here you go.
You mentioned a reward too.
Right, right. Take it.
Oh no. What'd that asshole tell you to say? He just made a disastrous assault on the power grid North of here. They lost three of our guards. As if we had 'em to spare...
He wanted some more people. For the next attack.
Ahhhhh, I knew it. As if we're not fucked enough.
Yep. And he needs some extra meatshields for the next one.
He forgot to ask you to look like you give a shit.
How could I lend you anyone else? Our security's weak as it is, and I can't pull armed men outta my ass.
True; but Dubravka has it worse right now.
Hm. It's true, they're being targeted more often lately. At least we have some walls left from before the War... Plus we're beginning to arm ourselves...
They'll attack with or without enough people. Yelena's orders.
Shit, she's calling the shots now? What, did she run outta booze? She's got more bloodlust than anyone...
If we lose more guards... All these Commonfolk...
The more people attack, the better our odds.
We should be thinking of defense sometimes.
Yelena's in charge. She knows what she's doing.
Her... Well, I should be the last person to doubt her proficiency in these shootouts, I've seen her work... But it's not an easy decision.
Maybe, with more people... Bandits'll stop attacking... More guards will return... Yeah, I'll lend you a couple guys. Damnit, please bring 'em back alive. You joinin' the fight too, Vulture?
They're paying me to.
Better not die, then. I'm sure Kolia will thank you profusely for your help... Agh... I'll send him a message later. Get gone, now.
Depends on the odds.
Right. Very cheeky. Get outta my sight, I'll send a message to Kolia. The guys'll show up soon. Now scram...
Seen you before. Returner, is it? Can I help you?
What do you need, Returner?
Got a lot on my mind... Please be quick.
What is it?
Make it quick.
Just want to chat.
Wanted to talk to you.
We've got to talk.
Was looking to trade...
Got anything to trade?
Let me see what you can trade.
Of course.
Never a bad time.
Sure... Let's get to it.
What do you want?
Be seeing you.
Back to work...
Right.
So be it.
Okay.
There's a bunker around here, right? I need to enter.
Need access to the bunker 'round here.
Was hoping to get inside a bunker nearby.
Here. Made the guns you asked for.
Crafted everything you ordered.
Here. I put together the guns you needed.
Kolia asked me to talk to you.
Kolia sent me.
You know Kolia?
Food shouldn't be a problem at this point, but... We've been struggling with deliveries and such. Help us out, will ya.
There's always something missing 'round here, and Vultures like you can help with our supplies. You in?
Good, good. This'll keep us going for a little while longer.
Bah, can't believe we couldn't handle this shit on our own. Sometimes I start to lose hope...
Sounds easy.
Ain't easy for us.
I'll think about it.
We're struggling here, Vulture.
Any other requests?
Thought the Rada were more independent.
You can count on me for this stuff.
I’m not gonna sugarcoat it: Bandits have been taking advantage of all these holes in the Palatines' defense, they're fucking us hard. Help drive 'em away.
It’s been tough to fend off Bandits with our little combat experience in the Rada... Won’t you help kill just one more squad?
You really helped us, and confirmed just how violent Zalesye is gonna be for the foreseeable future...
Nicely done. Maybe this'll inspire more of us to learn to shoot...
I'll show you how it's done.
The cowards around here won't be watching.
I'll think about it.
Come on, show us how tough you are.
Any other requests?
Your security issues are bigger than I thought.
I'll see you next time.
Don't have any work for you.
Check back with me later.
